title: Intelligent Visual Detection & Recognition
subtitle: Multi-Scale Feature Aggregation, Deformable Attention, and Continuous Uncertainty
description: Scientific investigation of advanced neural visual detection architectures. Focuses on deformable multi-scale feature pyramids, continuous bounding box distribution modeling, small-object detection in crowded environments, and set-prediction transformer decoders.
candidateDatasets: LVIS v1.0 Long-Tail Large Vocabulary Benchmark

statisticalProtocol.reporting: mean ± std across N >= 3 seeds, bootstrap 95% confidence intervals
statisticalProtocol.significanceMethod: Paired Student's t-test or Wilcoxon signed-rank test conforming to distribution characteristics; significance evaluated in context of experimental variance rather than mechanical p < 0.05 thresholds

milestones.title: SOTA Baseline Reproduction & Pipeline Standardization
milestones.deliverable: 100% reproducible training and evaluation pipeline for Deformable DETR and Modern Anchor-Free Detectors on MS COCO val2017 across 3 random seeds.

milestones.title: Multi-Scale Feature Aggregation for Small Objects
milestones.deliverable: Novel architectural module for small-object feature preservation under extreme scale variance; benchmarked on VisDrone and Sumatera aerial surveillance imagery.

milestones.title: Continuous Spatial Uncertainty & Distributed Detection
milestones.deliverable: Multi-agent collaborative visual detection with bounded spatial uncertainty for smart infrastructure monitoring; peer-reviewed journal submission.

title: Robust Multi-Object Tracking & Motion Perception
subtitle: State Association Stability, Camera Motion Compensation, and Occlusion Recovery
description: Research in temporal visual object association and motion dynamics. Solves trajectory fragmentation, severe visual occlusions, camera ego-motion jitter, and identity switching in dense crowds and automated traffic surveillance.

statisticalProtocol.reporting: mean ± std across N >= 3 seeds, TrackEval official benchmark outputs
statisticalProtocol.significanceMethod: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test on per-sequence association scores; verified against trajectory length distributions

milestones.title: Baseline Benchmark Reproduction: ByteTrack & BoT-SORT
milestones.deliverable: Reproduced and verified ByteTrack and BoT-SORT pipelines on MOT17 validation split with TrackEval metric conformance.

milestones.title: Weather-Invariant & Motion-Compensated Association
milestones.deliverable: Novel association algorithm fusing camera motion estimation with low-confidence detection recovery for adverse traffic monitoring.

milestones.title: Decentralized Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracking
milestones.deliverable: Scalable tracking framework across distributed non-overlapping camera networks for regional logistics and transportation corridors.

title: Robust Visual Perception in Adverse Environments
subtitle: Atmospheric Scattering, Monsoon Restoration, and Safety-Critical Calibration
description: Primary regional and physical research focus aligned with Sumatera's tropical maritime climate. Investigates physical radiative transfer modeling, heavy monsoon rain-streak removal, dense tropical haze restoration, low-light enhancement, and safety-critical Out-of-Distribution calibration.
primaryBenchmark: RESIDE Haze Benchmark & Dark Zurich Nighttime Suite
standardMetrics: mCE (mean Corruption Error relative to Clean)

statisticalProtocol.reporting: mean ± std across N >= 3 seeds with 95% bootstrap confidence bounds
statisticalProtocol.significanceMethod: Permutation testing and paired t-tests evaluating restoration fidelity and downstream task robustness gains

milestones.title: Sumatera Tropical Vision Benchmark (STVB) Curation
milestones.deliverable: Curation and release of the STVB dataset capturing torrential tropical rain, peatland haze, and nighttime plantation lighting.

milestones.title: Physics-Guided Deep Restoration & Dynamic Range Expansion
milestones.deliverable: Coupled radiative transfer and deep attention networks that simultaneously restore visibility and output calibrated detection probabilities.

milestones.title: Autonomous Self-Calibrating Sensors in Harsh Climates
milestones.deliverable: Self-adapting edge vision nodes capable of operating across decade-long continuous weather cycles without manual recalibration.

title: Vision-Centric Multimodal Perception
subtitle: Open-Vocabulary Grounding, Parameter-Efficient Adaptation, and Audio-Visual Fusion
description: Strategic extension exploring the integration of grounded language and spatial audio with visual perception. Investigates zero-shot open-vocabulary detection, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA / prefix tuning) of visual foundation backbones, and spatial audio-visual localization.
primaryBenchmark: ImageNet-1K Zero-Shot Transfer & RefCOCO Visual Grounding

statisticalProtocol.reporting: mean ± std across N >= 3 fine-tuning seeds for adapter parameterizations
statisticalProtocol.significanceMethod: Bootstrap resampling evaluation on zero-shot test prompts and paired significance tests for adapter ablation comparisons

milestones.title: CLIP Zero-Shot & LoRA Adaptation Baseline
milestones.deliverable: Reproduced parameter-efficient fine-tuning pipeline on OpenCLIP backbones with zero-shot transfer verification.

milestones.title: Open-Vocabulary Grounding for Agricultural Surveillance
milestones.deliverable: Visual-language grounding models capable of zero-shot novel agricultural pest and crop disease detection from natural language prompts.

title: Efficient Computer Vision & Edge AI Systems
subtitle: Quantization Arithmetic, Memory Bandwidth Optimization, and Sub-5W Embedded Inference
description: Strategic deployment focus targeting real-time embedded execution on resource-constrained hardware. Addresses uniform/non-uniform integer quantization (INT8/INT4), straight-through estimator Quantization-Aware Training, structured channel pruning, and memory bandwidth Roofline optimization.
primaryBenchmark: Edge Detection Pareto Suite (mAP vs FPS vs MB)
standardMetrics: Model Disk Footprint (MB) and Parameter Count (M)
Energy Consumption per Inference (Joules or mJ/frame)

statisticalProtocol.reporting: mean ± std across N >= 3 quantization-aware training runs, P50/P90/P99 latency across 1000 warmup/timed inference runs
statisticalProtocol.significanceMethod: Empirical Pareto dominance testing and Wilcoxon tests on latency distributions under thermal throttling constraints

milestones.title: Post-Training Quantization (INT8) & ONNX Runtime Benchmark
milestones.deliverable: Validated PTQ and QAT pipelines demonstrating <= 1.0% mAP loss with >= 3x memory footprint reduction on ARM/x86 targets.

milestones.title: Solar-Powered Sub-5W Edge Vision Nodes
milestones.deliverable: Autonomous off-grid vision edge nodes running real-time detection for remote coastal and forest perimeter monitoring.

milestones.title: Neuromorphic & Sub-Milliwatt Continuous Visual Sensing
milestones.deliverable: Event-driven ultra-low-power vision architectures for continuous decadal agricultural sensing; publication in top hardware/vision venues.

title: Spatial Intelligence & 3D Vision
subtitle: Monocular Depth Estimation, Visual Odometry, and Implicit Neural Radiance
description: Optional specialization in spatial AI, geometric computer vision, and 3D scene representation. Explores self-supervised monocular depth estimation, visual odometry drift correction, bundle adjustment, and neural implicit radiance representations (NeRF/Gaussian Splatting).
candidateDatasets: NYU Depth V2 Indoor RGB-D Benchmark
standardMetrics: RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error in meters)

statisticalProtocol.reporting: mean ± std across N >= 3 training seeds, official KITTI benchmark evaluation scripts
statisticalProtocol.significanceMethod: Paired hypothesis testing on trajectory error segments and depth distribution error bounds

milestones.title: Monocular Depth & Drift-Free Visual Odometry
